notes: The two ἐν tokens are analysed differently because the ASV realizes only the first, with the supplied using; rule 36 leaves a preposition unrepresented only where English realizes it nowhere at all, and the second phrase (nor a cloak of covetousness) carries no such word.
θεὸς μάρτυς is a verbless clause with a lexical-noun subject, so rule 63 puts the supplied is on μάρτυς; reading is with God would follow English word order, which rule 53 refuses.
ποτέ takes the whole at any time headed on the nominal time under rule 17; heading on any remains defensible.
